native_result.query: In which century did the Diversity in Pottery Form collapses and Diversity in Pottery Decoration increases simultaneuosly?
native_result.HypoA: Around 1800 BCE, Diversity in Pottery Form collapses, while Diversity in Pottery Decoration increases.
native_result.HypoB: Pottery Form diversity collapsed and Pottery Decoration diversity increased simultaneously in the 17th century BCE (bin 1700 BCE, i.e. 1700-1601 BCE; CE -1700; c. 3650 calBP). On the transition 1800 BCE -> 1700 BCE, Pottery Form Z fell from +0.74 to -1.13 (delta -1.87, collapse to the global minimum, sustained thereafter) while Pottery Decoration Z rose from -0.48 to +0.97 (delta +1.45) - the only 100-year transition with a simultaneous >=1-SD form collapse and decoration increase, and the first bin where the low-form/elevated-decoration state co-occurs and persists.
native_result.WorkflowB: Load capital.csv (comma decimals fixed; CE=-BCE; calBP=1950+BCE; 39 bins, 100-yr). Drop group/color. Sort ascending in time. First differences dForm=diff(ZKeform), dDec=diff(Zkeverz). Criterion A: same-transition dForm<=-1SD AND dDec>=+1SD -> uniquely 1700 BCE (-1.87/+1.45). Criterion B: bins with ZKeform==global min -1.13 AND Zkeverz>=0.97 -> first 1700 BCE (13 bins to 500 BCE). Criterion C: first bin of sustained simultaneous regime -> 1700 BCE (early EN 4300-4100 BCE excluded: decoration at global min -1.92, 'both low'). Cross-check: time_series raw byte-equal to ZKeform/Zkeverz on 37/37 overlapping bins; annual _inter ramp (0.74->-1.13; -0.48->0.97 across CE -1800..-1700) used only as confirmation. Final: 17th century BCE (1700-1601 BCE), equivalents CE -1700 / c. 3650 calBP.

sub_hypo.text: The 1700 BCE bin was the first occurrence of a sustained low-form/elevated-decoration regime, which persisted through 500 BCE.
sub_hypo.context: Archaeological capital data; 13 consecutive 100-year bins from 1700 to 500 BCE. The early EN bins at 4300–4100 BCE are excluded because decoration was at its global minimum of -1.92, representing a both-low state.
sub_hypo.relations: Pottery Form Z equals its global minimum of -1.13 while Pottery Decoration Z is at least +0.97; these conditions first co-occur in the 1700 BCE bin and persist for all 13 bins through 500 BCE.
